English: Persons living with HIV (PLHIV) receiving antiretroviral therapy have increased risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD).
Luganda: Abantu abalina HIV (PLHIV) abali ku ddagala lya mukeenenya balina akatyabaga ka waggulu okufuna obulwadde bw’omutima (CVD).
Yoruba: Àwọn èèyàn tó ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV (PLHIV) tó sì ń gba ìtọ́jú àìlera antiretroviral ní ewu púpọ̀ tó jẹ mọ́ àrùn ọkàn àti ti ẹ̀jẹ̀ (CVD).

Hausa: Mutane Masu Ɗauke da HIV (PLHIV) masu karɓar maganin rigakafi suna ƙara haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya (CVD).
Northern Sotho: Batho ba go phela ka HIV (PLHIV) bao ba amogelago dihlare tša anthiretherobaerale ba kotsing ye kgolo ya go swarwa ke bolwetši bja ditšhikamadi tša pelo (CVD).
Amharic: ጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና እያገኙ ያሉ እና ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች (ኤ.ጋ.የ.ሰ)  ስርአተ ልብ ወቧንቧ በሽታን (ስ.ል.ወ.በ) የማዳበር ከፍተኛ እድል አላቸው፡፡

English: Integration of services for hypertension (HTN), the primary CVD risk factor, into HIV clinics is recommended in Uganda.
Luganda: Okutobeka obujjanjabi eri obulwadde bw’entunnunsi (HTN), akatyabaga k’okufuna CVD, mu bulwaliro bwa HIV kyetaagisa mu Uganda.
Yoruba: Asopọ̀ iṣẹ́ fún ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru (HTN), èyí tó jẹ́ ewu CVD àkọ́kọ́, sínú àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn HIV tí wọ́n ṣe ìdúró fún ní orílé-èdè Uganda.
Zulu: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsizakalo zephika (HTN), ukuyingozi ehamba phambili ekutholeni i-CVD, emitholampilo ye-HIV kuyanconywa e-Uganda.
Hausa: An bayar da shawar haɗin ayyukan hauhawar jini (HTN), babban haɗarin da ke kawo Cututtukan Zuciya, a cikin asibitocin HIV a ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Go šišinya gore go kopantšhwe ditirelo tša haephathenšene (HTN), e lego motheo o mogolo wa go hlola bolwetši CVD, go ba karolo ya dikliniki tša HIV nageng ya Uganda.
Amharic: በኡጋንዳ ለ ስ.ል.ወ.በ አደጋ ዋነኛ ምክንያት ለሆነው ለከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት (ከ.ደ.ግ) የሚሰጡ አገልግሎቶችን ከኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች ጋር ማቀናጀት ይመከራል፡፡

English: Our prior work demonstrated multiple gaps in implementation of integrated HTN care along the HIV treatment cascade.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwaffe okwasooka kwalaga emiwaatwa egiwera mu kuteeka mu nkola okutobeka obujjanjabi eri HTN ku kipande ekiriko ebigobererwa mu kujjanjaba HIV.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ wa ìṣáájú ṣe àfihàn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àlààfo tí a lè lò fi sẹ àmúlò ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú HTN pẹ̀lu ọgbọ́ń ìtọ́jú HIV lẹ́sẹẹsẹ.
Zulu: Umsebenzi wethu wangaphambili ubonise izikhala eziningi ekusetshenzisweni kokunakekelwa okudidiyelwe kwe-HTN ekulashweni kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Ayyukanmu na baya sun nuna giɓi da yawa a cikin aiwatar da haɗin gwiwar kulawar HTN tare da maganin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo wa rena wa peleng o laeditše dikgoba tše ntši go kabo ya tlhokomelo ye e kopantšwego ya HTN go sepela mmogo le ditirelo tša kalafo ya HIV.
Amharic: ከዚህ በፊት የሰራናቸው ስራዎች ከኤችአይቪ ህክምና ስኬቶች ጋር የ ከ.ደ.ግ እንክብካቤን የማቀናጀት ተግባር ላይ ብዙ ክፍተቶች እንዳሉ ያሳያሉ፡፡

English: In this study, we sought to explore barriers to and facilitators of integrating HTN screening and treatment into HIV clinics in Eastern Uganda.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twagenderera okuzuula emiziziko n’ebiyambako okutobeka okukebera n’okujjanjaba HTN mu bulwaliro bwa HIV mu Buvanjuba bwa Uganda.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, a wá láti ṣàwárí àwọn ohun ìdènà sí ti àwọn tó wà ní ìdí ìbojúwo ìṣàkóso ìsopọ̀ HTN àti ìtọ́jú sí àwọn ilé ìwòsàn HIV ní Ilà-Oòrùn ilẹ̀ Uganda.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, sifuna ukuhlola izithiyo kanye nabagqugquzeli bokuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-HTN emitholampilo ye-HIV eMpumalanga ne-Uganda.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, mun nemi yin la’akari da shingaye da masu gudanarwa na haɗa gwajin HTN da magani zuwa asibitocin HIV a Gabashin ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, re lekile go utolla mapheko le dinolofatši tša go kopantšhwa ga tlhohlobo le kalafo ya HTN ka dikliniking tša HIV ka Bohlabela bja Uganda.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት በምስራቅ ኡጋንዳ የከ.ደ.ግ ማጣራት እና ህክምናን ከኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች ጋር ለማቀናጀት ያሉትን እንቅፋቶች እና ደጋፊ ምክንያቶችን ለመዳሰስ ፈልገን ነበር፡፡

English: We conducted a qualitative study at three HIV clinics with low, intermediate, and high HTN care cascade performance, which we classified based on our prior work.
Luganda: Twakola okunoonyereza okw’okulombojja mu bulwaliro bwa HIV busatu obulina obuweereza eri HTN obwa wansi, obwa wakati wamu n’obwa waggulu, bwe twabinjawaza nga tusinziira ku kunoonyereza kwaffe okwasooka.
Yoruba: A ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tó lágbára ní ilé-ìwòsàn mẹ́ta pẹ̀lú kékeré, agbede méjì, àti iṣẹ́ ìtọ́jú HTN tó ga gan, èyí tí a fi pamọ́ kúrò ní àwùjọ tó sì dá lórí iṣẹ́ tí a ti ṣe sẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Senze ucwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu emitholampilo emithathu ye-HIV enokusebenza kwe-HTN okuphansi, okumaphakathi, nokuphezulu, esikuhlele ngokusekelwe emsebenzini wethu wangaphambili.
Hausa: Mun gudanar da bincike mai inganci a asibitoci guda uku masu cutar HIV tare da ƙarancin aiki da matsakaici da kuma babban aikin kulawar HTN, wanda muka rarraba bisa ga aikinmu na baya.
Northern Sotho: Re dirile dinyakišišo tša khwalithethifi go dikliniki tše tharo tša HIV tše di abelanago ka ditirelo tša tlhokomelo ya maemo a fase, a magareng, le a godimo tša HTN, tšeo re di hlophilego go lebeletšwe mošomo wa rena wa peleng.

English: Guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR), we conducted semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions with health services managers, healthcare providers, and hypertensive PLHIV (n = 83).
Luganda: Nga tweyambisa olutiba oluyambako okuteeka okunoonyereza mu nkola (CFIR), twategeka okubuuzibwa wamu n’okukubaganya ebirowoozo ne bamaneja b’obulwaliro, abajjanjabi n’abalwadde ba PLHIV abalina entunnunsi (n = 83).
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìtọ́sọ́nà àjọ fún Ìṣọ̀kan Ìmúṣẹ Iṣẹ́ Ìwádìí (CFIR), a ṣèdá àwọn ìfọ̀rọlwánilẹ́nuwò tí wọ́n rọra ṣètò àti àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú àwọn alákóso àwọn ètò ìlera, àwọn olùpèsè iṣẹ́ ìlera, àti àwọn PLHIV tó ní ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru (n = 83).
Zulu: Siqondiswa uHlaka Oludidiyelwe Lokuqaliswa Kocwaningo (i-CFIR), senze izingxoxo ezingahleliwe kanye namaqembu abahlanganyeli nabaphathi abaphethe ezempilo, abahlinzeki bezempilo, kanye nabantu abaphila nephika PLHIV (n = 83).
Hausa: An jagorance shi ta Ƙarfafa Tsarin Bincike don Aiwatar (CFIR), mun gudanar da tsararrun tambayoyin tattaunawa da kuma tattaunawa ta rukuni tare da manajojin sabis na kiwon lafiya, masu kula da kiwon lafiya, da kuma Mutane Masu Ɗauke da HIV masu ɗauke da Hauhawar Jini (n = 83).
Northern Sotho: Ka go hlahlwa ke Tlhathollo ye e Tiišeditšwego ya Dinyakišišo tša Phethagatšo (CFIR), re swere dipoledišano tše di beakantšwego le ditherišano tša dihlopha le balaodi ba ditirelo tša maphelo, baabaditirelo tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo, le PLHIV bao ba šomago ka malwetši a kgatelelo ya madi a magolo (n = 83).

English: The barriers include lack of functional BP machines, inadequate supply of anti-hypertensive medicines, additional workload to providers for HTN services, PLHIV’s inadequate knowledge about HTN care, suboptimal knowledge, skills and self-efficacy of healthcare providers to screen and treat HTN, and inadequate planning for integrated HTN/HIV services.
Luganda: Emiziziko mulimu ebbula ly’ebyuma bya BP ebikola, okugaba eddagala erirwanyisa obulwadde bw’entunnunsi eritamala, obuvunaanyizibwa obulala eri abo abatuusa obujjanjabi bwa HTN, abantu abalina obulwadde bwa mukeenenya obutaba na magezi gawera ku HTN, amagezi, obukugu n’okwekkiririzaamu okutono eri abajjanjabi okusobola okukebera n’okujjanjaba HTN, awamu n’okuteekateeka okutono eri obuweereza bw’okutobeka HTN/HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìdènà náà ní àìní ẹ̀rọ tó ń mójútó ẹ̀jẹ̀ tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa, àìlèpèsè àwọn òògùn tó ń gbógun ti ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, àfikún iṣẹ́ fún àwọn olùpèsè iṣẹ́ HTN, ìmọ̀ lórí àwọn PLHIV tí kò tó nípa ìtọ́jú HTN, ìmọ̀ tún kéré ọgbọ́n àti agbáraẹni tí àwọn tóń pèsè ìlera fi ń tọ́jú HTN, àti ètò ìsopọ̀ìtọ́jú HTN/HIV tí kò pé.
Zulu: Izithiyo zihlanganisa ukushoda kwemishini ye-BP esebenzayo, ukungeneli kwemithi elwa nomfutho wegazi ophakeme, umthwalo owengeziwe kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ze-HTN, ulwazi olwanele lwabantu abaphila ne-PLHIV mayelana nokunakekelwa kwe-HTN, ulwazi oluncane, amakhono kanye nokusebenza kahle kwabahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze bahlole futhi belaphe i-HTN, kanye nokungahleleli okwanele kwezinsizakalo ezididiyelwe ze-HTN/HIV.
Hausa: Matsalolin sun haɗa da rashin injunan BP masu aiki, rashin isassun magunguna masu hana hauhawar jini da ƙarin nauyin aiki ga masu samar da sabis na HTN da ƙarancin ilimin kula da Mutane Masu Ɗauke da PLHIV game da kulawar HTN da ingantaccen ilimi da ƙwarewa da ingancin kai na masu ba da lafiya don dubawa da kula da HTN, da kuma rashin isassun tsare-tsare don haɗin gwiwar ayyukan HTN/HIV.
Northern Sotho: Mapheko a akaretša tlhokego ya metšhene ye e šomago ya BP, kabo ye e sa lekanago ya dihlare tša twantšho ya haephathenšene, mošomo o boima wa tlaleletšo go baabaditirelo tša HTN, tsebo ye e sa lekanelago ya di-PLHIV mabapi le tlhokomelo ya HTN, tsebo ya ka fase ga maemo a godimodimo, mabokgoni le katlego tša baabaditirelo ba tlhokomelo ya tša maphelo go hlahloba le go alafa HTN, le peakanyo ye e sa lekanelago ya ditirelo tše di kopantšwego tša HTN/HIV.
Amharic: እንቅፋቶቹ ደግሞ የሚከተሉትን ያካትታሉ፤ የሚሰሩ የደም ግፊት መለኪያ ማሽኖች አለመኖር፣ በቂ ያልሆነ የጸረ-ከፍተኛ የደም ብዛት መድሃኒቶች አቅርቦት፣ ኤ.ጋ.የ.ሰ ስለ ከ.ደ.ግ እንክብካቤ ያላቸው አነስተኛ ግንዛቤ፣ የጤና አገልግሎት አቅራቢዎች ከ.ደ.ግን አጣርቶ ለማወቅ እና ለመመርመር ያላቸው አነስተኛ ግንዛቤ፣ ክህሎት እና በእራስ የመስራት ችሎታ ማነስ እና የተቀናጁ የ ከ.ደ.ግ/ኤችአይቪ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት ያለው አመርቂ ያልሆነ የእቅድ አወጣጥ ናቸው፡፡

English: Relative advantage of offering HTN and HIV services in a one-stop centre, simplicity (non-complex nature) of HTN/ HIV integrated care, adaptability, and compatibility of HTN care with existing HIV services are the facilitators for HTN/HIV integration.
Luganda: Omukisa gw’okutuusa obujjanjabi bwa HTN ne HIV mu kifo kimu, obwanguyirwa (embeera y’okuba nga si kizibu) mu bujjanjabi bw’okutobeka HTN ne HIV, obusobozi bw’okumanyiira, n’okugendana kw’obujjanjabi eri HTN ne HIV bye biyambako okutobeka HTN ne HIV.
Yoruba: Àńfààní àti pèsè àwọn iṣẹ́ HTN àti HIV ní àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n lè dúró sí kan, ayédẹ̀rọ̀ (ìṣẹ̀dá tí kò ní ẹ̀ka) ti ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú HTN/HIV, tó lè faradà, tí ó sì wà ní ìbámu ìtọ́jú HIV àti ìtọ́jú HTN tó wà tẹ́lẹ̀ jẹ́ ìrànwọ́ fún ìsopọ̀ HTN/HIV.
Zulu: Inzuzo ehlobene yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ze-HTN kanye ne-HIV endaweni eyodwa, ubulula (imvelo engeyona inkimbinkimbi) yokunakekelwa okudidiyelwe kwe-HTN/HIV, ukuguquguquka, nokuhambisana kokunakekelwa kwe-HTN nezinsizakalo ezikhona ze-HIV yizona ezihamba phambili zokuhlanganisa i-HTN/HIV.
Hausa: Dangantakar da take tattare da bayar da sabis na HTN da HIV a cikin cibiya-ɗaya, zai sauƙaƙa (rashin sarƙaƙiyar yanayi) na haɗaɗɗen kulawar HTN/ HIV, daidaitawa da dacewa da kulawar HTN tare da sabis cutar HIV da ake da su su ne masu haɓaka haɗin HTN/HIV.
Northern Sotho: Mohola wo o bonagalago wa go fana ka ditirelo tša HTN le HIV lefelong la kabo-moka la ditirelo, nolofatšo ya tlhokomelo (sebopego sa go se hlakahlakane) ye e tiišeditšwego ya HTN/ HIV, boitokišetšo, le kgokaganyo ya tlhokomelo ya HTN le ditirelo tša HIV tše di lego gona ke dinolofatši tša kopantšho ya HTN/HIV.
Amharic: የ ከ.ደ.ግ እና የኤችአይቪ አገልግሎቶችን በአንድ ቦታ በሚገኝ ማእከል ላይ የመስጠት አንጻራዊ ጥቅም ፣ የተቀናጀ የ ከ.ደ.ግ/ኤችአይቪ እንክብካቤ ቀላልነት (ያልተወሳሰበ አሰራር) ፣ መላመድ እና አሁን ላይ እየተሰጡ ካሉ የኤችአይቪ አገልግሎቶች ጋር የከ.ደ.ግ እንክብካቤ ተኳሃኝነት ለ ከ.ደ.ግ/ኤችአይቪ ቅንጅት ደጋፊ ምክንያቶች ናቸው፡፡

English: The remaining CFIR constructs were non-significant regarding influencing HTN/HIV integration.
Luganda: Ebizimbo bya CFIR ebisigadde tebyalina nkizo ku kusalawo okutobeka HTN ne HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọnìtúmọ̀ CFIR yòókù ò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ ní ìdí kan pàtàkì nípa ìsopọ̀ HTN/HIV.
Zulu: Ukwakhiwa okusele kwe-CFIR bekungabalulekile mayelana nokuba nomthelela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-HTN/HIV.
Hausa: Sauran tsare-tsaren CFIR ba su da mahimmanci game da tasirin haɗin Hauhawar Jini/HIV.

English: Using the CFIR, we have shown that while there are modifiable barriers to HTN/HIV integration, HTN/HIV integration is of interest to patients, healthcare providers, and managers.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa CFIR, tulaze nti newankubadde nga waliwo emiziziko egikyusika eri okutobeka HTN ne HIV, enkola y’okutobeka HTN ne HIV eyagalwa abalwadde, abajjanjabi ne bamaneja.
Yoruba: Nípa lílo CFIR, a ti fin hàn pé àwọn ìdíwọ́ ìyípadà wà fún ìdàpọ HTN/HIV, ìdàpọ HTN/HIV jẹ́ ohun tó mums láyà àwọn aláìlera, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ elétò àbò, àti àwọn adarí.
Zulu: Ngokusebenzisa i-CFIR, sibonise ukuthi nakuba kunezithiyo ezingalungiseka ekuhlanganisweni kwe-HTN/HIV, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-HTN/HIV kuyathakazelisa iziguli, abahlinzeki bezempilo, kanye nabaphathi.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da CFIR, mun nuna cewa yayin da akwai matsalolin da za a iya gyarawa zuwa haɗin HTN/HIV, haɗin HTN/HIV zai ba wa marasa lafiya da masu kula da lafiya da kuma manajoji sha’awa.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša CFIR, re bontšhitše gore le ge go na le mapheko ao a ka nolofatšwago go kopantšho ya HTN/HIV, kopantšho ya HTN/HIV e hwetša thekgo go balwetši, baabaditirelo tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo, le balaodi.
Amharic: ተ.ት.ም.ማን በመጠቀም ከ.ደ.ግ/ኤችአይቪ ቅንጅት ላይ ያሉ እንቅፋቶች ሊቃኑ የሚችሉ መሆናቸውን ያሳየን ሲሆን፣ የ ከ.ደ.ግ/ኤችአይቪ ቅንጅት ለህምመተኞች፣ ለጤና አገልግሎት አቅራቢዎች እና ለአስተዳዳሪዎች ጠቃሚ ነው፡፡

English: Improving access to HTN care among PLHIV will require overcoming barriers and capitalizing on facilitators using a health system strengthening approach.
Luganda: Okutuusa obujjanjabi bwa HTN mu PLHIV kijja kwetaagisa okuvvuunuka emiziziko n’okweyambisa ebintu ebiyambako okuyita mu nkola ey’okunyweza ekitongole ky’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣe ìmúdára àti ráàyè sí ìtọ́jú HTN láàárín àwọn PLHIV yóò nílò kí wọ́ borí àwọn ìdènà àti fífi agbárasí àwọn olùrànlọ́wọ́ nípa siṣàmúlò ọ̀nà ẹ̀tọ́ ètò ìlera.
Zulu: Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwe-HTN kubantu abaphila nePL-HIV kuzodinga ukunqoba izithiyo nokusebenzisa abagqugquzeli kusetshenziswa indlela yokuqinisa uhlelo lwezempilo.
Hausa: Haɓaka samun damar kulawar Hauhawar Jini a tsakanin Mutane Masu Ɗauke da HIV zai buƙaci shawo kan shingaye da yin amfani da masu gudanarwa ta amfani da tsarin ƙarfafa tsarin kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Go kaonafatša go fihlelelwa ga ditirelo tša tlhokomelo ya HTN magareng ga PLHIV go tla nyaka go tla ka tharollo ya mapheko le šomiša monyetla wa dinolofatši go šomišwa mokgwa wa matlafatšo ya lenaneo la maphelo.
Amharic: ከ ኤ.ጋ.የ.ሰን የ ከ.ደ.ግ እንክብካቤ አገልግሎቶች የማግኘት እድልን ለማሻሻል፣ የጤና ሲስተም ማጠናከሪያ ዘዴን በመጠቀም እንቅፋቶችን መወጣት እና ደጋፊ ምክንያቶች ላይ ደግሞ ጠንክሮ መስራትን ያስፈልጋል፡፡

English: These findings are a springboard for designing contextually appropriate interventions for HTN/HIV integration in low- and middle-income countries.
Luganda: Ebizuulo bino ntandikwa y’okuyiiya engeri ennuŋŋamu ez’okuyambako mu kutobeka HTN ne HIV mu mawanga agayingingiza ekitono n’ago agayingiza mu ngeri ensaamusaamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn àwárí wọ̀nyí jẹ́ orísun fún ìdásí tó péye fún HTN/HIV ní àwọn oríléèdè àti ọwọ́ ọ̀ya.
Zulu: Lemiphumela iyinkomba yokuklama ukungenelela okufanele ngokomo ukuze kuhlanganiswe i-HTN/HIV emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi.

Yoruba: Ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, tàbí haipatẹńsọ́ọ̀nù, máa ń mú 1 nínú 3 àwọn àgbàlagbàmẹta tó ní HIV ní ilẹ̀ Uganda.
Zulu: Iphika, noma umfutho wegazi ophezulu, uhlasela umuntu omdala o-1 kwaba-3 abaphila ne-HIV e-Uganda.
Hausa: Hawan jini, ko hauhawar jini, yana shafar 1 a cikin manya 3 da suke zaune tare da cutar HIV a ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Kgatelelo ya madi a magolo, goba haephathenšene, e ama motho o 1 go ba 3 bao ba phelago ka HIV nageng ya Uganda.
Amharic: በኡጋንዳ ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎችን፣ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ወይም ደም ብዛት ከ3 አዋቂዎች 1ሰውን ያጠቃል፡፡

English: Since people suffering from these two conditions together must make regular trips to hospitals, researchers say it makes sense for existing HIV clinics to also diagnose and treat hypertension, instead of sending their hypertensive patients elsewhere.
Luganda: Engeri gye kiri nti abantu abalina obulwadde buno bwombiriri bateekeddwa okugenda mu malwaliro buli kaseera, abanoonyereza bagamba nti kikola amakulu ng’obulwaliro obujjanjaba HIV bugasseeko okukebera entunnunsi, okusinga okusindika abalwadde baabwe abalina entunnunsi mu bifo ebirala.
Yoruba: Níwọ̀n ìgbà tí àwọn èèyàn tó ń bá àwọn ipò méjéèjì yìí fínra papọ̀ gbọ́dọ̀ máa ṣe ìbẹ̀wò sí ilé ìwòsàn lóòrèkóòrè, àwọn oníwádìí sọ pé ó ní òye nínú fún àwọn ilé ìwòsàn HIV tó wà nílẹ̀ láti mọ̀ àti láti tọ́jú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, kàkà kí wọ́n máa rán àwọn aláìsàn ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru lọ sí ibòmíràn.
Zulu: Njengoba abantu abanalezi zimo ezimbili bendawonye kufanele bavakashele ezibhedlela njalo, abacwaningi bathi kunengqondo ukuthi imitholampilo ekhona ye-HIV nayo ixilonge futhi yelaphe iphika, esikhundleni sokuthumela iziguli ezinephika kwezinye izindawo.
Hausa: Tun da yake mutanen da suke fama da waɗannan yanayi guda biyu tare dole ne su yi tafiye-tafiye akai-akai zuwa asibitoci, masu binciken sun ce yana da ma’ana ga asibitocin HIV da ke da su su ma su gano tare da magance hawan jini, maimakon tura majinyatansu masu hauhawar jini zuwa wani wuri.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge batho bao ba swerwego ke malwetši a ka bobedi ba swanetše go etela dipetleleng nako le nako, banyakišiši ba bolela gore ke tshwanelo gore dikliniki tše di lego gona tša HIV le tšona di lemoge go ba gona ga haephathenšene le go e alafa, e sego go romela balwetši ba haephathenšene go gongwe.
Amharic: በእነዚህ ሁለት የጤና ሁኔታዎች በአንድላይ የሚሰቃዩ ሰዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል መደበኛ ጉብኝት ማድረግ ስላለባቸው፣ ተመራማሪዎች አሁን ላይ ያሉ የኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ያለባቸውን ታማሚዎች ወደሌላ ቦታ ከሚልኩ ይልቅ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊትንም ቢመረምሩ እና ቢያክሙ ትርጉም ይሰጣል ይላሉ፡፡

English: Unfortunately, many HIV clinics have still not successfully integrated hypertension care with the HIV care they already provide.
Luganda: Eky’omukisa omubi, obulwaliro bungi obujjanjaba HIV tebunnayongera bujjanjabi bwa ntunnunsi ku bujjanjabi bwa HIV bwe butuusa ku bantu.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láànú pé, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn HIV ò tí ì ṣe àseyọrí láti ṣe àsopọ̀ ìtọ́ju ẹ̀jẹ̀ rírú pẹ̀lú ìtọ́ju ́HIV tí wọ́n ti pèsè sílẹ̀.
Zulu: Ngeshwa, imitholampilo eminingi ye-HIV ayikakahlanganisi ngempumelelo ukunakekelwa kwephika nokunakekelwa kwe-HIV esuvele ikunikeza.
Hausa: Abin takaici, yawancin asibitocin HIV ba su sami nasarar haɗa gwiwar kulawar hauhawar jini tare da cutar HIV da suka bayar ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka madimabe, bontši bja dikliniki tša HIV ga se tša tšwa di kopantšha tlhokomelo ya haephathenšene le tlhokomelo ya HIV ka katlego tšeo di šetšego di fana ka yona.
Amharic: በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ፣ ብዙ የኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች አሁንም ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት እንክብካቤን እየሰጡ ካሉት የኤችአይቪ አገልግሎቶች ጋር አልተቀናጁም፡፡

English: Researchers investigated why integrated care works or does not work in eastern Uganda.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baanoonyereza lwaki okujjanjaba okutobeke kukola oba tekukola mu Buvanjuba bwa Uganda.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí ṣe ìwádìí lórí ìdí tí ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú i ń ṣiṣé tàbí tí kò fi ṣiṣẹ́ ní ìlà-Oòrùn Uganda.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphenye ukuthi kungani ukunakekelwa okudidiyelwe kusebenza noma kungasebenzi empumalanga ye-Uganda.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun binciki dalilin da yasa haɗin gwiwar kulawar ke aiki ko ba ya aiki a gabashin ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile diphatišišo tša gore ke ka baka la eng tlhokomelo ye e kopantšwego e šoma goba e sa šome ka bohlabela bja Uganda.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በምስራቅ ኡጋንዳ የተቀናጀ እንክብካቤ ለምን እንደሚሰራ ወይም እንደማይሰራ መርምረዋል፡፡

English: Understanding the challenges will help to develop better ways to integrate hypertension and HIV care.
Luganda: Okutegeera okusoomooza kujja kuyambako okuteekawo enkola ezisingako ez’okutobeka obujjanjabi bw’entunnunsi ne HIV.
Yoruba: Níní òye nípa àwọn ìpèníjà yóò ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti lè pèsè ọ̀nà tó dára láti ṣe àsopọ̀ fún ìtọ́jú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru àti HIV.
Zulu: Ukuqonda izinselelo kuzosiza ukwakha izindlela ezingcono zokuhlanganisa iphika kanye nokunakekelwa kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Fahimtar ƙalubalen zai taimaka wajen haɓaka ingantattun hanyoyi don haɗa gwiear kulawar hauhawar jini da kuma cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go kwešiša ditlhohlo go tla thuša go akanya ditsela tše kaone tša go kopantšha tlhokomelo ya haephathenšene le HIV.
Amharic: ተግዳሮቶቹን በሚገባ መረዳት ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት እና የኤችአይቪ እንክብካቤን በተሻለ መልኩ ለማቀናጀት የሚረዱ መንገዶችን ለመቅረጽ ያግዛል፡፡

English: They interviewed healthcare workers in HIV clinics and patients living with both HIV and hypertension.
Luganda: Baabuuza bakozi mu bulwaliro obujjanjaba HIV n’abalwadde abalina HIV awamu n’entunnunsi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi ọ̀rọ̀ wá àwọn elétò ìlera ní ilé ìwòsàn lẹnu wò ̀ti àọn alaáìsàn tó ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV àti ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru.
Zulu: Baxoxisane nabasebenzi bezempilo emitholampilo ye-HIV kanye neziguli eziphila ne-HIV kanye nephika.
Hausa: Sun yi hira da ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya a asibitocin HIV da kuma marasa lafiya da suke ɗauke da ƙwayar cutar HIV da kuma hauhawar jini.
Northern Sotho: Ba swere dipoledišano le bašomedi ba tlhokomelo ya tša maphelo ka dikliniking tša HIV gammogo le balwetši bao ba phelago ka HIV le ba haephathenšene.
Amharic: በኤችአይቪ ክልኒኮች ለጤና አገልግሎት ባለሞያዎች እና ከሁለቱም ከኤችአይቪ እና ከከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ጋር ለሚኖሩ ታማሚዎች ቃለመጠይቅ አድርገዋል፡፡

English: They analysed the responses using standard scientific methods for improving healthcare interventions.
Luganda: Beekaliriza ebyanukulo nga bakozesa obukodyo bw’ekinassaayansi obw’olugerero okusobola okutumbula engeri y’okwenyigira mu kutuusa obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn ìdáhùn nípa ṣíṣàmúlò àwọn ọ̀nà ìmọ̀-ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti lè ṣe dáadáa lórí ètò ìlera.
Zulu: Bahlaziye izimpendulo besebenzisa izindlela zesayensi ezijwayelekile zokuthuthukisa ukungenelela kokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Hausa: Sun yi nazarin amsoshin ta amfani da daidaitattun hanyoyin kimiyya don inganta ayyukan kula da lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba sekasekile dikarabo ba šomiša mekgwa ya saentshe ya motheo go kaonafatša go tsena ka bogare tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: የጤና አገልግሎት ጣልቃ ገብነቶችን ለማሻሻል ምላሾቻቸውን የተለመዱ ሳይንሳዊ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም ገምግመዋል፡፡

English: They found that HIV clinics lacked skilled personnel and resources, including blood pressure machines and medications.
Luganda: Baazuula nti obulwaliro obujjanjaba HIV tebwalina bakozi batendeke awamu n’ebikozesebwa, omuli ebyuma ebikebera puleesa kw’ossa obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn HIV ò ní àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ tí ó ní òye púpọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun èlò, pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹ̀rọ tó ń mójútó ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti àwọn òògùn.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi imitholampilo ye-HIV ayinabo abantu abanamakhono nezinsiza, okuhlanganisa imishini yomfutho wegazi nemithi.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa asibitocin HIV ba su da ƙwararrun ma’aikata da kayan aiki, gami da na’urorin hawan jini da kuma magunguna.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore dikliniki tša HIV di be di hloka bašomedi bao ba nago le bokgoni le methopo, go akaretša metšhene ya go lekola kgatelelo ya madi le dihlare.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች የተካነ የሰው ሃይል እና እንደ የደም ግፊት መለኪያ ማሽኖች እና መድሃኒቶች ያሉ ግብአቶች እንደሌሏቸው አግኝተዋል፡፡

English: Patients also didn’t know that they could get medical attention for both diseases at HIV clinics.
Luganda: Abalwadde nabo baali tebamanyi nti basobola okufuna obujjanjabi bw’endwadde zombi ku bulwaliro obujjanjaba HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn ò tún mọ̀ pé àwọn lè rí ìtọ́júgbà fún ààrùn méjéèjì ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn tí a dá sílẹ̀ fún ìtọ́jú HIV.
Zulu: Iziguli nazo bezingazi ukuthi zingathola usizo lwezempilo kuzo zombili izifo emitholampilo ye-HIV.
Hausa: Har ila yau, marasa lafiya ba su san cewa za su iya samun kulawar likita ga cututtukan biyu a asibitocin HIV ba.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba be ba sa tsebe le gore ba ka hwetša thušo ya kalafo ya malwetši ka bobedi dikliniking tša HIV.
Amharic: ታማሚዎች ደግሞ በኤችአይቪ ክሊኒኮች ውስጥ ለሁለቱም በሽታዎች የጤና አገልግሎት ማግኘት እንደሚቻል አያውቁም ነበር፡፡

English: Other researchers have studied how Africa can integrate hypertension and HIV care.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abalala banoonyerezza ku ngeri Afirika gy’eyinza okutobeka obujjanjabi bw’entunnunsi mu bwa HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn oníwádìí mìíràn ti ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí lórí bí ilẹ̀ Africa ti lè ṣẹ ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru àti HIV.
Zulu: Abanye abacwaningi bafunde ukuthi i-Afrika ingahlanganisa kanjani iphika kanye nokunakekelwa kwe-HIV.
Hausa: Wasu masu binciken sun yi nazarin yadda Afirka za ta iya haɗa kulawar hauhawar jini da kuma cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bangwe ba dirile diphatišišo mabapi le ka moo Afrika e ka kopantšhago tlhokomelo ya haephathenšene le ya HIV.
Amharic: ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች አፍሪካ እንዴት ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊትን እና የኤችአይቪ እንክብካቤን ማቀናጀት እንደምትችል አጥንተዋል፡፡

English: However, this was the first time that the standard scientific method mentioned above, known as the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR), was used to look at specific solutions to the problem.
Luganda: Wabula, guno gwe mulundi ogwasooka akakodyo k’ekinassaayansi ak’olugerero akamenyeddwa waggulu, akamanyiddwa nga Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR), okukozesebwa okutunuulira ebirina okukolebwa okugonjoola ekizibu.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, èyí ni ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí ọ̀nà ìmọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì tí a mẹnubà lókè, tí a mọ̀ sí Ìṣọ̀kan Fún Ìmúṣe iṣẹ́ Ìwádìí (CFIR), ni a lò láti wá ojútùú sí àwọn ìṣòro náà.
Zulu: Nokho, bekungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kusetshenziswe indlela yesayensi ejwayelekile eshiwo ngenhla, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Consolidated Framework ye Implementation Research (CFIR), ukuze kubhekwe izisombululo ezithile zenkinga.
Hausa: Duk da haka, wannan shi ne karo na farko da aka yi amfani da daidaitacciyar hanyar kimiyya da aka ambata a sama, wadda aka sani da Ƙarfafa Tsarin Bincike don Aiwatarwa (CFIR), don duba takamaiman hanyoyin magance matsalar.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, se e bile lekga la mathomo leo mokgwa wa saentshe wa motheo wo o laeditšwego ka godimo, wo o tsebjago bjalo ka Tlhathollo ye e Tiišeditšwego ya Dinyakišišo tša Phethagatšo (CFIR), o bego o šomišwa go lekodišiša ditharollo tše itšego tša bothata.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ከላይ የተጠቀሰው የተጠናከረ የትግበራ ምርመራ ማእቀፍ (ተ.ት.ም.ማ) የተባለው መደበኛ ሳይንሳዊ ዘዴ በተለይ ችግሩ ላይ ያተኮሩ መፍትሄዎችን ለማምጣት ጥቀም ላይ ሲውል የመጀመሪያው ነው፡፡

English: The researchers cautioned however that in their study, many patients were unaware of integrated HIV-hypertension care, because they had never been introduced to it.
Luganda: Wabula abanoonyereza baalabula nti mu kunoonyereza kwabwe, abalwadde bangi baali tebawulirangako ku bujjanjabi bwa HIV nga butobekeddwamu obw’entunnunsi, kubanga baali tebakiwulirangako.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀ àwọn oníwádìí ṣe ìkìlọ̀, pé nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn aláị̀sàn ni ò mọ̀ nípa ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú HIV-ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, torí wọn ò mọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisile nokho ukuthi ocwaningweni lwabo, iziguli eziningi bezingazi ngokunakekelwa okudidiyelwe kwe-HIV-hypertension, ngoba azikaze zifundiswe ngakho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaxin cewa a cikin binciken da suka yi, yawancin marasa lafiya ba su da masaniya game da haɗin gwiwar kulawar hauhawar jini da cutar HIV, saboda ba a taɓa shigar da su ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, banyakišiši ba lemošitše gore ka dinyakišišong tša bona, bontši bja balwetši ba be ba sa lemoge ka tlhokomelo ye e kopantšwego ya HIV le haephathenšene, ka gore ba se nke ba tsebišwa ka yona.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ በጥናታቸው፣ ብዙ ታማሚዎች ከዛሬ በፊት ማንም ስላላስተዋወቃቸው ስለ ኤችአይቪ-ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት የተቀናጀ እንክብካቤ ምንም ግንዛቤ እንዳልነበራቸው አሳስበዋል፡፡

English: This meant many could not properly answer the interview questions.
Luganda: Kino kyategeeza nti bangi tebaasobola kuddamu bulungi bibuuzo by’okubuuzibwa.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé ọ̀pọ̀ ò lè dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè tí wọ́n fi wá wọn lẹ́nu wò.

Amharic: ይህ ማለት ደግሞ አብዛኛዎቸ ሰዎች ላቃለመጠይቅ ጥያቄዎች ተገቢ መልስ መስጠት አልቻሉም ነበር ማለት ነው፡፡

English: They therefore recommended that future research should focus on patients’ perspectives.
Luganda: Noolwekyo baateesa nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kutunuulire endowooza z’abalwadde.
Yoruba: Nítorí náà wọ́n gbà wọ́n níyànjú pé kí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú ó fi ojú àwọn aláìsàn wọ ó.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke bayale ukuthi ucwaningo oluzayo kumele lubheke ukuqonda kweziguli.
Hausa: Don haka, sun ba da shawarar cewa ya kamata bincike na gaba ya mayar da hankali ne a kan ra’ayoyin marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona go šišintšwe gore gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di bee šedi e kgolo go kwešišo ya balwetši.

English: They also said more studies are needed to compare the costs and benefits of integrated hypertension and HIV care.
Luganda: Baagattako ne bagamba nti okunoonyereza okulala kwetaagibwa okugeraageranya ebisale n’emiganyulo egiri mu kutobeka obujjanjabi bw’entunnunsi mu bwa HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé wọ́n nílò ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí láti fi wo ìjọra iye àti àǹfààní ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru àti HIV.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi kusadingeka olunye ucwaningo ukuze kuqhathaniswe amanani nenzuzo yokwelashwa kwephika ne-HIV okuhlanganisiwe.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce ana buƙatar ƙarin nazari don kwatanta farashi da fa'idojin haɗin gwiwar kulawar hauhawar jini da kuma cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore go hlokega dinyakišišo tše ntši go bapetša ditshenyegelo le dikholego tša tlhokomelo ye e kopantšwego ya haephathenšene le ya HIV.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የተቀናጀ የከፍተኛ ደም ግፊት እና የኤችአይቪ እንክብካቤን ጥቅሞች እና ገዳቶች ለማነጻጸር ተጨማሪ ጥናቶች ያስፈልጋሉ ብለዋል፡፡

English: Ugandan and other African health authorities can use insights from this research to design integrated care for hypertension and HIV.
Luganda: Abeebyobulamu okuva mu Uganda n’abo okuva mu mawanga ga Afrika amalala basobola okukozesa ebiri mu kunoonyereza kuno okuteekateeka obujjanjabi bw’entunnunsi obutobeke ne HIV.
Yoruba: Orílé-èdè Uganda àti àwọn aláṣe ètò ìlera ilẹ̀ Africa yòókù lè lo òye inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí láti ṣe ìsopọ̀ ìtọ́jú fún ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru àti HIV.
Zulu: Iziphathimandla zezempilo zase-Uganda nezinye zase-Afrika zingasebenzisa imininingwane evela kulolu cwaningo ukuze zenze ukunakekelwa okudidiyelwe komfutho wegazi ophezulu kanye ne-HIV.
Hausa: Yuganda da sauran hukumomin kiwon lafiya na Afirka na iya amfani da fahimtar wannan bincike don tsara haɗin gwiwar kulawar hauhawar jini da kuma cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Balaodi ba tša maphelo ba Uganda le ba dinaga tše dingwe tša Afrika ba ka šomiša tshedimošo go tšwa dinyakišišong tše go akanya tlhokomelo ye e kopantšwego ya haephathenšene le ya HIV.

English: With such interventions, we can eliminate avoidable deaths due to hypertension, since it will be diagnosed early and treated when patients seek care for HIV.
Luganda: N’okwenyingiramu okw’engeri eyo, tusobola okumalawo okufa okuva ku ntunnunsi okusobola okwewalibwa, engeri gye kiri nti kujja kukeberebwa nga bukyali era kujjanjabwe ng’abalwadde bagenze okufuna obujjanjabi bwa HIV.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú irú àwọn ìdásí bẹ́ẹ̀, a lè mú àwọn ikú tí a lè yẹra fún torí ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí wọn yóò tètè rí i àti tọ́jú ẹ̀ nígbà tí àwọn aláìsàn bá lọ gba ìtọ́jú HIV.
Zulu: Ngokungenelela okunjalo, singakwazi ukuqeda ukufa obekugwemeka ngenxa yephika, njengoba kuzotholakala kusenesikhathi futhi kwelashwe lapho iziguli zifuna ukunakekelwa nge-HIV.
Hausa: Da irin waɗannan ayyukan, za mu iya kawar da mutuwar da za a iya gujewa saboda hauhawar jini, tun da za a gano shi da wuri kuma a yi masa magani a lokacin da marasa lafiya suka nemi kulawa da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ka go tsena ka bogare moo, re ka thibela mahu ao a ka efogwago a go hlolwa ke haephathenšene, ka ge e tla lemogwa e sa le nako le go alafša ge balwetši ba hwetša kalafo ya HIV.
